name: Play a free untapped land that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, before anything else about the land drop is decided, play a land from hand that already enters untapped and makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - a Swamp that lets Thoughtseize be cast. This never costs life and never asks the fetch machinery to run, so it goes first: a land this good is never worse than holding it. Prefers a basic first, since esper-blink's own duals and utility lands are never scarcer to hold onto than a basic. Only turns 1-2, only with the land drop still available, and only mine, precombat main, an empty stack. Does not ask about a shockland (open-shock-unlocks) or a fetch (open-fetch-unlocks); those pay something or need a search and rank below this. Stands down once two or more untapped mana is already up: the seat-admitted orchid-phantom-breaks-tron play (eldrazi-ramp only) needs that much to cast the two-mana flier, and this land-drop decision is judged before that turn's land is played, so on a genuine turn 1-2 board this key costs nothing here - untapped mana cannot reach 2 before the first or second land drop without a mana source this deck does not run.
